items.title: CPI, Kroger earnings and 9/11 remembrance: What to watch Friday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton tees up the stories set to make headlines Friday, September 11, including a fresh read on the US economy with the Consumer Price Index (CPI) due before the opening bell, Kroger's (KR) Q2 earnings report, and a moment of silence expected at both the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq ahead of the Opening Bell to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks.

items.title: Kroger Cuts Sales Forecast, Oracle Gains | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Kroger (KR) is moving as it trimmed its annual sales guidance due to fierce competition for grocery spending. - Oracle (ORCL) shares are higher as the software company's results featured better-than-expected cloud revenue amid strong AI demand. - Restoration Hardware (RH) shares are on the move after the home furnishing retailer's quarterly earnings beat amid a weaker housing market and consumer spending environment.

items.title: Kroger Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) reported modest second-quarter identical sales growth while maintaining its full-year profit outlook, as pharmacy-related pressures, a Cyclospora outbreak and cautious consumer spending weighed on the top line.
